case_title: MICHAEL GOLDBLATT VS. RAUL A. RIVAS

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-23-2015 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GOLDBLATT, MICHAEL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RIVAS, RAUL A. DBA RARA TRUCKING $5,095.45 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,095.45, WHEN MAKING SUCH A WIDE TURN DEFENDANT AND AS DRIVER HAD A DUTY TO MAKE SURE NO ONE WAS IN THE FAR RIGHT POSITION ALSO ATTEMPTING TO TURN RIGHT. DEFENDANT WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ACCIDENT. PLAINTIFF PROVIDED SUFFICIENT SUPPORT FOR HIS DAMAMGES CLAIM. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT RIVAS, RAUL A. DBA RARA TRUCKING
